description: Turns increment and decrement triggers into an absolute voltage, adding or subtracting a fixed step on each trigger.

params.text: Sets exponential slew on the output, 0 to 5 seconds; patching the slew input takes this knob out of use.
Sets the voltage each trigger adds or subtracts, 0 to 5V.

inputs.text: Sets the slew of the output by voltage, 0-5V, in place of the SLEW knob.
A trigger adds one step to the output voltage.
A trigger subtracts one step from the output voltage.
Sets the output to the voltage present here, and again on every change of that voltage.

outputs.text: The accumulated voltage, clamped to the range picked on the menu: 0-5V, 0-10V, -5V to 5V or -10V to 10V.

menu: Voltage range — 0..5V, 0..10V, -5..5V, -10..10V, or Unbounded, which applies no limit to the accumulated voltage.

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
